consolidated_summary: The page identifies four biologically active amines that are addictive drugs: cocaine (from coca leaves), nicotine (from tobacco), mescaline (from peyote cactus), and morphine (from opium poppies). These compounds are classified as alkaloids, naturally produced by plants for defense, and many are known for their psychoactive and addictive properties.
